name: bitbucket-mcp-server

tools.name: repositories
tools.description: List repositories in a Bitbucket workspace, or get details for a single repository when `repo_slug` is provided.

workspace.description: Bitbucket workspace name. Falls back to BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE env var if not provided.

repo_slug.description: Repository slug/name. If provided, returns a single repository; otherwise lists repositories.

page.description: (list only) Page number or opaque next page URL

tools.name: pull-requests
tools.description: List pull requests for a repository, or get details for a single pull request when `pr_id` is provided.

workspace.description: Bitbucket workspace name. Falls back to BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE env var if not provided.

pr_id.description: Pull request ID. If provided, returns a single PR; otherwise lists.

state.description: (list only) Filter by state. Accepts a single state or an array of states: OPEN, MERGED, DECLINED, SUPERSEDED

page.description: (list only) Page number or opaque next page URL

tools.name: create-pull-request
tools.description: Create a new pull request in a repository

workspace.description: Bitbucket workspace name. Falls back to BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE env var if not provided.

source_branch.description: Source branch name (the branch with your changes)

destination_branch.description: Destination branch name (defaults to the repository's main branch)

description.description: Description of the pull request (supports Markdown)

close_source_branch.description: Whether to close the source branch after the PR is merged

tools.name: update-pr-description
tools.description: Update the title and/or description of a pull request

workspace.description: Bitbucket workspace name. Falls back to BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE env var if not provided.

title.description: New title for the pull request

description.description: New description for the pull request

tools.name: get-pr-diff
tools.description: Get the diff/changes for a specific pull request

workspace.description: Bitbucket workspace name. Falls back to BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE env var if not provided.

tools.name: pr-comments
tools.description: List comments on a pull request, or get details for a single comment when `comment_id` is provided.

workspace.description: Bitbucket workspace name. Falls back to BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE env var if not provided.

comment_id.description: Comment ID. If provided, returns a single comment; otherwise lists.

page.description: (list only) Page number or opaque next page URL

tools.name: create-pr-comment
tools.description: Create a comment on a pull request, or reply to an existing comment by specifying a parent comment ID

workspace.description: Bitbucket workspace name. Falls back to BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE env var if not provided.

file_path.description: Path to the file for inline comments

from_line.description: Line number in the old version of the file (for inline comments)

to_line.description: Line number in the new version of the file (for inline comments)

parent_id.description: ID of the parent comment to reply to

tools.name: resolve-pr-comment
tools.description: Resolve or unresolve a pull request comment thread

workspace.description: Bitbucket workspace name. Falls back to BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE env var if not provided.

comment_id.description: Top-level comment ID for the thread to resolve or unresolve

action.description: Whether to resolve or unresolve the comment thread

tools.name: commits
tools.description: List recent commits for a repository, or get details for a single commit when `commit_hash` is provided.

workspace.description: Bitbucket workspace name. Falls back to BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE env var if not provided.

commit_hash.description: Commit hash. If provided, returns single commit details; otherwise lists recent commits.

branch.description: (list only) Branch name (defaults to main branch)

page.description: (list only) Page number or opaque next page URL

workspace.description: Bitbucket workspace name. Falls back to BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE env var if not provided.

page.description: Page number or opaque next page URL returned by Bitbucket pagination

pagelen.description: Number of items per page (default: 10, min: 10, max: 100)

workspace.description: Bitbucket workspace name. Falls back to BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE env var if not provided.

page.description: Page number or opaque next page URL returned by Bitbucket pagination

pagelen.description: Number of items per page (default: 10, min: 10, max: 100)

tools.name: pipelines
tools.description: List pipelines for a repository, or get details for a single pipeline when `pipeline_uuid` is provided.

workspace.description: Bitbucket workspace name. Falls back to BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE env var if not provided.

pipeline_uuid.description: Pipeline UUID. If provided, returns a single pipeline; otherwise lists all pipelines.

page.description: (list only) Page number or opaque next page URL

tools.name: trigger-pipeline
tools.description: Trigger a new pipeline for a repository

workspace.description: Bitbucket workspace name. Falls back to BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE env var if not provided.

ref_name.description: Name of the branch or tag

commit_hash.description: Full hash of the commit to run the pipeline on

selector_pattern.description: Pattern for the selector (e.g., custom pipeline name)

variables.description: Environment variables for the pipeline (key-value pairs)

tools.name: pipeline-steps
tools.description: Pipeline step operations. Use `action: "list"` to list all steps, `"get"` to fetch a single step's metadata, `"log"` to fetch a single step's log output. `step_uuid` is required when `action` is `get` or `log`.

workspace.description: Bitbucket workspace name. Falls back to BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE env var if not provided.

step_uuid.description: Step UUID. Required when action is `get` or `log`.

page.description: (action=list only) Page number or opaque next page URL

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search across repositories, pull requests, issues, and commits in a workspace

workspace.description: Bitbucket workspace name. Falls back to BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE env var if not provided.

query.description: Search query (searches in titles, descriptions, and content)

limit.description: Maximum number of results per type

tools.name: health-check
tools.description: Check connectivity to Bitbucket API and validate credentials

tools.name: get-metrics
tools.description: Get server performance metrics and statistics
